title: Sister at Oberlin and his mother as a hotel baker
summary: His sister attended Oberlin, which made him want to go; his mother baked at a Muskogee hotel and he ate hot rolls there.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: But that's another thing that gave me the idea about going to school. Because my sister went to Oberlin. And I had aspirations...
Oh yeah, I had aspirations to go to Oberlin.
How did she get to Ohio? How did your sister get to Ohio from Oklahoma?
Well, my mother...they sent her off to school. But the school didn't cost as much it does now, you know...
Well, they didn't have that much either.
That's remarkable. I think that's remarkable that they could do that.

Well, my family I guess made... They worked for good people, and they made pretty good money. My mother, the last couple of years I was at school, she was a baker at one of the biggest hotels in Muskogee. And I remember, I used to get up early in the morning, and you know where I had my breakfast? If I could get down there by about twelve o'clock(?), the time she had them rolls coming out, I'd have some hot rolls and marmalade...
